scenarios.name: Switch locked views after showing an origin plane

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/blank-metric-part.opd` is active in the MCAD Software
the user copies Primary as BrowserView, activates it and enables its Lock option
The MCAD Software has an empty part with a locked copied view active
the YZ origin plane is hidden
the user chooses Visibility from the YZ origin plane context menu
the YZ origin plane is visible
the user activates the Primary view
the YZ origin plane remains visible
the user activates the locked copied view
the YZ origin plane remains visible
the copied view displays its active and locked indicators
